summary: Iteration 154: Tested Zero-AI System Search with Maybe Candidates feature. All 17 backend tests passed. Frontend UI testing confirmed all features working: 3-tab layout (Sourced, System Suggestion, Search Bank), multi-dimensional score bars, Maybe Candidates section with incomplete data warning, candidate profile dialog, and refresh functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/suggestions returns both 'suggestions' (confirmed matches) and 'maybe_candidates' arrays
✅ Response includes: status, suggestions, maybe_candidates, total_matched, total_maybes, total_scored
✅ Each suggestion has all dimension scores: score, skill_match_score, experience_match_score, ctc_fit_score, location_fit_score, notice_fit_score, stability_score, tfidf_score
✅ Confirmed suggestions have is_maybe=False, maybe candidates have is_maybe=True
✅ Maybe candidates have data_completeness < 60 and missing_data_fields array
✅ Authentication required for both endpoints (401/403 without token)
✅ Frontend: AddCandidateToMandateDialog has 3 tabs with data-testid attributes
✅ Frontend: System Suggestion tab shows 50 confirmed matches + 20 maybe candidates (70 total)
✅ Frontend: Candidate cards show circular score badges with 'Good Fit' labels
✅ Frontend: Multi-dimensional score bars (Skills, Exp, CTC, Location, Notice, Stability, Text Sim)
✅ Frontend: Matched skills in green badges, missing skills in red badges
✅ Frontend: Maybe Candidates section with 'incomplete data' warning visible after scroll
✅ Frontend: Clicking candidate name opens full CandidateProfileDialog with tabs (Profile, Experience, Education, Activity, Timeline, Audit Log)
✅ Frontend: Refresh button triggers re-matching (shows 'Matching candidates...')
seed_data_creation: Used existing job ID 26c3e482-2026-4fb5-a820-5a869e90ae9b with pre-generated suggestions (50 confirmed + 20 maybes)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Zero-AI System Search with Maybe Candidates feature fully tested. The matching engine uses pure Python TF-IDF cosine similarity with 300+ skill synonyms. Key functions: calculate_fast_match_score (line 995), _calc_ctc_fit (line 773), _calc_notice_fit (line 827), _calc_stability (line 873), _calc_location_fit (line 742), _tfidf_similarity (line 902), _data_completeness (line 944). job_suggestions.py separates candidates into confirmed (is_maybe=False) and maybes (is_maybe=True) at lines 116-120. Frontend AddCandidateToMandateDialog.jsx has data-testid attributes: tab-sourced, tab-suggestions, tab-search, refresh-suggestions-btn, candidate-card-{id}.
